abstract: We establish two multi-period coordinate-covering theorems for bounded-span polynomial translate carriers H_p(f; S_k) (S_k subset [0, W]) in square windows W_n(x_0, y_0) = [x_0, x_0 + n)^2 of side n = lambda*p = (a + theta)*p (a = floor(lambda) >= 1, theta = lambda - a in [0, 1)). Previous window-blind multi-period analyses weighted every horizontal residue by its torus average E[w_y] = lambda, forcing the five-translate bound alpha_d(lambda) to cross 9/5 = 1.80 at lambda ~= 1.166 (A_5) and 1.3196 (S_4) and yielding only the trivial 2n bound on permutation-polynomial translate families for k >= 3. Observing that the (a+1)-fold wrapping rows I_y(y_0) and a-fold non-wrapping rows I_y^c(y_0) form two contiguous cyclic arcs in F_p, we prove first (Theorem 1) a universal monodromy-free bound via Weil's character sum estimate: covering I_y^c(y_0) horizontally and the preimage of I_y(y_0) - S_k vertically certifies alpha(H_p(f; S_k) cap W_n(x_0, y_0))/n <= gamma_infty(a + theta) + 2W/p + O(d*sqrt(p)*log^2(p)/p) with gamma_infty(a + theta) = 2*(a + theta^2)/(a + theta) for every polynomial f in F_p[x] of degree 2 <= d < p, including permutation polynomials, strictly below 1.80 on ((29 - sqrt(41))/20, (29 + sqrt(41))/20) ~= (1.1298, 1.7702) and (12/5, 5/2) = (2.40, 2.50). Second (Theorem 2), because Vieta relations couple multiple roots on the same fiber, we use the one-distinguished-root transfer of no_three_in_line_10 v3 [2] and a Twin-Blowup Lemma to reduce residue-level covers on each strip m_y in {a, a+1} to the Unsplit One-Distinguished-Root Multi-Server Queue driven solely by full root counts R(v) with uniform expected root weight lambda = a + theta, certifying k = 5..8 translates across all d >= 3 (S_d, A_d) and k = 9, 10 for D_{(1,5)}, C_3 below 1.80n across wide multi-period intervals. The unrestricted No-Three-In-Line problem remains open.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: 1. Resolved the Vieta root-coupling counterexample in Theorem 2: replaced the false multi-root binomial splitting model with the Unsplit One-Distinguished-Root Multi-Server Queue (using the one-distinguished-root transfer of no_three_in_line_10 v3 [2, Sections 3.1 & 7.1] and our Twin-Blowup Vertex-Cover Lemma 3.1), driven solely by unsplit full modular root counts R(v) with uniform expected weight lambda = a + theta, and proved concavity and 1-Lipschitz monotonicity in theta directly from the pointwise minimum of affine block cover costs without multi-root coupling. Updated all values in Tables 1-3 and verify_twostrip_multiserver_queue.py accordingly. 2. Replaced slice-only finite-prime checks at p = 1009 with full-window seam-inclusive physical covers (unsplit_blownup_physical_cover) that pre-cover the 2(k-1) seam residue rows horizontally, lift the unsplit twin-blowup Konig cover on both strips to physical coordinates (H, V) in W_n(x_0, y_0), and verify point-by-point that every carrier point in W_n(x_0, y_0) is covered. 3. Downgraded Theorem 3 to a short Proposition 3.1 reporting only the two remaining 4-translate span-5 classes S = (0,1,2,5) and S = (0,1,3,5) completing [3, Table 2]. 4. Restricted Proposition 5.1 strictly to the certified finite-prime obstruction at p = 47 (n = 94) with an explicit primal/dual Konig witness (matching = vertex cover = 43, ratio 86/47) alongside the 4243/2350 > 1.80 all-lines dual packing witness. 5. Added citations to Kudriashov [8] (qualifying single-graph permutation-monomial exclusions in 2p windows) and Glover [9].
title: Two-Strip Wrap-Around Stratification and Unsplit One-Distinguished-Root Multi-Server Queue Exclusion of Permutation and Bounded-Span Polynomial Translate Families Below 1.8n
